1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { parse } from '../src/parse.js'
3	
4	describe('parse', () => {
5	  it('parses a simple two-row CSV', () => {
6	    expect(parse('a,b,c\n1,2,3')).toEqual([
7	      ['a', 'b', 'c'],
8	      ['1', '2', '3'],
9	    ])
10	  })
11	
12	  it('handles a quoted field containing a comma', () => {
13	    expect(parse('name,quote\nAlice,"hello, world"')).toEqual([
14	      ['name', 'quote'],
15	      ['Alice', 'hello, world'],
16	    ])
17	  })
18	
19	  it('handles escaped double quotes inside a quoted field', () => {
20	    expect(parse('id,note\n1,"she said ""hi"""')).toEqual([
21	      ['id', 'note'],
22	      ['1', 'she said "hi"'],
23	    ])
24	  })
25	
26	  it('handles newlines inside a quoted field', () => {
27	    expect(parse('id,bio\n1,"line one\nline two"')).toEqual([
28	      ['id', 'bio'],
29	      ['1', 'line one\nline two'],
30	    ])
31	  })
32	
33	  it('returns an empty array for empty input', () => {
34	    expect(parse('')).toEqual([])
35	  })
36	
37	  it('parses a single row with no newline', () => {
38	    expect(parse('a,b,c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
39	  })
40	
41	  it('handles empty fields', () => {
42	    expect(parse('a,,c')).toEqual([['a', '', 'c']])
43	  })
44	
45	  it('handles trailing empty field', () => {
46	    expect(parse('a,b,')).toEqual([['a', 'b', '']])
47	  })
48	
49	  it('handles leading empty field', () => {
50	    expect(parse(',b,c')).toEqual([['', 'b', 'c']])
51	  })
52	
53	  it('handles a trailing newline', () => {
54	    expect(parse('a,b\n1,2\n')).toEqual([
55	      ['a', 'b'],
56	      ['1', '2'],
57	    ])
58	  })
59	
60	  it('handles CRLF line endings', () => {
61	    expect(parse('a,b\r\n1,2')).toEqual([
62	      ['a', 'b'],
63	      ['1', '2'],
64	    ])
65	  })
66	
67	  it('handles an empty quoted field', () => {
68	    expect(parse('a,"",c')).toEqual([['a', '', 'c']])
69	  })
70	
71	  it('handles a field that is just an escaped quote', () => {
72	    expect(parse('"""""')).toEqual([['""']])
73	  })
74	
75	  it('handles multiple quoted fields in a row', () => {
76	    expect(parse('"a","b","c"')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
77	  })
78	})
